intro: 5 pieces of jackfruit come to roughly 120 kcal (estimate). The calories mainly come from natural sugar and starch in the thick flesh.
diet: Yes, jackfruit is still a fruit with fibre and a satisfying sweetness. But it's higher in calories than most other fruits. The usual issue is buying a whole tub at the pasar malam and finishing it in one sitting. Take 5 pieces, that's enough.
tips: When you buy a tub of jackfruit, put 5 pieces on a plate first.
Eat it after a meal of rice with protein, not as a snack when you're super hungry.
If you cook gulai nangka muda, use less santan and add chicken or fish.

swap.name: Watermelon, 2 slices
swap.why: Half the calories, lots of water, and easy to get at cut-fruit stalls.

faq.q: What's the difference between nangka and cempedak?
faq.a: Nangka is bigger, with crunchier flesh and a milder smell. Cempedak is smaller, with soft sticky flesh and a stronger smell.
Can. Boil or roast them first, don't eat them raw. They taste like chestnuts and contain starch, so count them in your calories too.

faq.q: How do I get jackfruit sap off my hands and knife?
faq.a: Rub cooking oil on your hands and knife before cutting. If it's already stuck, rub with oil first, then wash with soap.
